title: Uma ch’am tukuñ yant’äwi
intro: Mä comunidadax jupanakan amtapar arxatañatakix irpirinak munasaw mä comandante jupanakar utt’ayañapatak mayipxäna. Kunapachatï mayitapax jaysatäxän ukhaxa, ajllit jaqix pächasiñampiw uñjasïna, kunattix uka jaqix janiw kunjamtï suyapkäna ukhamäkänti. Janïr qhipa ch’axwäwix utjkipanx aka machaq irpirix ejercito ukan chiqpach chiqañchäwip yant’añapänwa, mä sanu, ukampis wali jach’a, jark’aqasiñ yant’awimpi.
clues: Nayax mä comandante ukhamaw utt’ayawayta, kunawsatix markajax mä irpirir Allah-an thakipan ch’axwañapatak mayipkäna ukhaxa.
Nayan pachpa markajat waljaniw qalltan nombramientojat jisktʼasipjjäna, janiw qamirïkti ukat jachʼa familianïkti sasaw sapjjäna.
Nayax ajllitätwa kunatix Allah jupax walja yatiñanak churawayitu ukat mä ch’aman jañchin jach’a jach’a tukuñaw churitu.
Diosan uttʼayatätajat mä qhana chimpujja, Pacto Arcajj kuttʼanjjänwa, uka Arcajj angelanakan aptʼatäjjänwa, ukajj iyawsirinakan chuymanakaparuw sumankañ apaniwayi.
Soldadonakajampi sarapkayäta ukhajja, mä jawir jakʼan yantʼatäñwa yatiyayäta.
Nayax ejercitojaruw kamachiyäta, khititix jawir manqhar umañ munki ukax janiw nayamp chikt’atäkaniti, ukampirus khitinakatix mä cucharada ukaki amparapar aptapki ukanakax qhiparapxani.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
